label: rescore-direct
_why: Re-scores all five pop-consumption approaches against DIRECTLY MEASURED pop consumption instead of the residual (buy - our modelled buildings - trade). The residual target scored building error as pop error and, measured directly, flattered the pop model rather than merely adding noise (FINDINGS F23), so every earlier column value needs redoing.
_note: ONE market per run. The breakdown returns multi-KB formatted text per good; at two markets per run the debug log hit 2.1 MB against a 5x512 KB ring and the block was cut off after 43 of ~72 goods (no C2done marker). One market lands near 1 MB and completes. Each run carries that market's member countries' per-pop SoL AND its breakdown at the SAME tick, so the per-pop column is scored strictly within one run; each market runs twice so the between-run spread of the measured target can be separated from model error.
